shared_elements: human/anthropomorphic face with eyes and mouth
stylized heads shown in profile or frontal within compact rounded outlines
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic faces rendered with heavy-lidded eyes and rounded, compact outlines, and both use fine incised curvilinear detail, but that is close to the limit of correspondence. A is a three-dimensional seated/contorted figure with limbs, head and body in a single sculptural pose, whereas B is a flat two-column grid of repeated, self-contained sign blocks with no figural scene, so arrangement and relationships share essentially nothing.
